cost_model.fees: round-trip taker fee from live InstrumentMeta, 2 * taker_fee.fraction * price. Never hardcoded: the vendor doc's sample values are wrong for BTC (hard invariant 1)
cost_model.funding: accrued per 8h interval crossed, from the live funding rate
cost_model.sensitivity: every headline result is re-run at 2x slippage. An edge that disappears there is not robust enough to deploy, because the estimate itself carries error
cost_model.shared_with_live: the same formula the risk engine charges, asserted by test rather than assumed (specs/08 acceptance criterion 10)
cost_model.slippage: a fraction of price, applied adversely on entries and stops; never on targets

decision_rules.CUT: a bespoke strategy that fails its benchmark comparison is cut, NOT tuned. Tuning until it beats the benchmark is fitting the benchmark, which is worse than having none
decision_rules.PROMOTE: validated: true and validation_multiplier -> 1.0. Requires passing the §7.1 test against C4-X1, the §10 benchmark comparison, and the §8 sensitivity check
decision_rules.REVISE: permitted ONCE, and only for a defect — never because the result disappointed
decision_rules.confidence: no confidence value is published anywhere until Phase 16 says so
decision_rules.harness_rule: if C4-X2 backtests well, the BACKTEST is suspect, not the strategy. Audit for look-ahead, survivorship in level definitions, cost under-modelling and fill logic before accepting any other result from the same harness
decision_rules.random_entry_rule: if a strategy cannot beat C4-X1 with statistical significance, its signal contributes nothing and the strategy is cut. Applies to all four classes

fill_model.entry: the WORSE of {trigger price, next 1m bar open}, plus slippage. Never the trigger
fill_model.intrabar_ambiguity: when one bar contains both the stop and the target, the STOP is assumed first. Always, and never resolved by selectively consulting finer data
fill_model.open_at_window_end: marked at the final close and EXCLUDED from realised statistics
fill_model.stop: if the bar's range gaps beyond the stop, the fill is the bar's OPEN, not the stop
fill_model.target: fills at the target price when the bar's range contains it; no slippage (limit order). A favourable gap beyond the target is deliberately not credited

hypotheses.if_false: the regime model, the strategy, or the backtest is wrong. Determining which is more valuable than the headline result and is a required deliverable
hypotheses.prediction: C4-A performs poorly in Axis-P mean-reverting regime cells

hypotheses.if_false: if the hit rate is low the mechanism is absent; if the tail is good, check the fill model before believing it
hypotheses.prediction: C4-C shows a high hit rate and a poor tail

hypotheses.if_false: for Class 2/3, the trailing exit is cutting winners; for Class 1/C4-C, the edge rests on a few lucky events
hypotheses.prediction: Class 2 and Class 3 show high profit concentration; Class 1 and C4-C show low concentration

hypotheses.if_false: the gap rule is not being applied, or the sample contains no gap events yet
hypotheses.prediction: the mean realised R on stopped trades is worse than -1.0R

hypotheses.if_false: the harness is suspect: audit before accepting any other result from it
hypotheses.prediction: C4-X2 (unconditioned Bollinger touch) does NOT backtest well

metric_definitions.hit_rate: count(r_multiple > 0) / n, published with its 95% Wilson score interval and n
metric_definitions.loss_tail_p95_r: 95th percentile of |r_multiple| over losing trades, linear interpolation
metric_definitions.max_drawdown_r: largest peak-to-trough decline of the cumulative r_multiple curve, ordered by exit time; expressed in R, not percent
metric_definitions.mean_r: arithmetic mean of r_multiple over closed trades
metric_definitions.median_r: median of r_multiple over closed trades; reported alongside the mean always, because they diverge for skewed payoffs and the mean alone hides which
metric_definitions.percentile: linear interpolation on the sorted sample: v[floor(q(n-1))] blended with the next value by the fractional part
metric_definitions.r_multiple: (exit_price - entry_price) * sign(direction) / |entry_price - initial_stop|, weighted across partial exits; initial_stop is fixed at entry and never updated
metric_definitions.sharpe_per_trade: mean_r / stdev_r over closed trades. REJECTED as sufficient output
metric_definitions.sortino_per_trade: mean_r / stdev of negative r_multiples only
metric_definitions.stopped_mean_r: mean r_multiple over trades exited by stop or trail. If materially worse than -1.0R, real risk exceeds published risk and liq_safety is re-derived
metric_definitions.top5_dependency: sum of the 5 largest r_multiples / sum of all r_multiples
metric_definitions.top_decile_share: sum of the largest ceil(n/10) r_multiples / sum of all r_multiples

contraction_percentile.unit: percentile of the trailing VOL_RATIO distribution

liq_safety.unit: multiples of R beyond the stop

portfolio_vol_target.band: operator-set; everything in specs/08 §4 is derived FROM it

regime_quantile_count.band: 3 then 2 — an escalation sequence, not a search range

swing_atr_multiple.band: 0.5 - 1.0 is the plausible range: below 0.5 cross-asset dispersion rises, above 1.0 the 24-bar window stops holding a confirmed pivot of each kind. A single value shared across assets and timeframes.

swing_confirmation_bars.band: none — a small odd integer, not tuned
